name: ZoomEye (cyberspace search engine API v2, keyed)
tier_rationale: P053 final condition 1: registry tier unknown (Chinese operator; queries reveal targets; the LGPD art. 33 international transfer is not reviewed). Excluded at AMBER, AMBER+STRICT and RED; CLEAR/GREEN only with --allow-unknown; IOC_TYPES selectors only. A promotion needs legal_dpo's written decision and keeps the AMBER+ exclusion.

reliability.justification: Scan-engine observations of varying age; unknown-tier provider; honeypot rows are flagged by the provider and never pivoted.

error_markers.reason: ZoomEye: error object in an HTTP 200 body (code/error instead of results)

zoomeye.description: ZoomEye API key (sent only in the API-KEY header)
zoomeye.plan_hint: business = a company/team ZoomEye account on a plan recorded by legal and procurement together with the LGPD art. 33 data-transfer decision (P053 FC1/FC2)

search.title: ZoomEye API v2 search (POST https://api.zoomeye.ai/v2/search, base64 query, API-KEY header): hosts, services, web assets

terms.quote: Key-terms: a company/team account on a plan recorded by legal before it runs under corporate. default_enabled=False.

search.notes: Quote: binding council text (P053 FC2). No key: HTTP 401 {code:50000, error:'login_required'} -> NEEDS_KEY (FC3). Success = code 60000. Points per search depend on the plan (not published: daily cap of 20 searches until the plan is recorded). The web deep link https://www.zoomeye.ai/searchResult?q=<base64> is a manual link only (FC5); www.zoomeye.ai is never requested.
